name: Orifushi Akina
source:
The second oldest of the Orifushi sisters, Akina is the same age and grade as [url=/c14083]Haruomi[/url]. Serious and a perfectionist honor student, Akina excels at housework, studies and sports, and on to top it off, she's cute. She's like an idol at the school Haruomi attends. For some reason, she really wants to take care of Haruomi, which brings out her jealous side.

[Based on [URL=http://www.omega-star.jp/web/kano/character.html]official website[/URL]]
